The '''Pacific Ocean''' is the largest of the world's five oceans, which appears in {{SA}}.

==Description==
Only the North Pacific Ocean makes a physical appearance in the {{3D}}. It is located on the western coast of the [[United States of America]].

The ocean is shown as an explorable large body of water that surrounds the state of San Andreas.

The Pacific Ocean features [[fauna]], returning from {{VC}}{{'}}s [[Ocean Bay]], as well as sea plants. In addition to the returning animals from ''GTA Vice City'', the ocean also features [[jellyfish]]es and [[starfish]]es. [[Sharks (animal)|Sharks]] are still present, though they only appear in rare occasions near [[Gant Bridge]]. None of the animals found in the water are hostile to the player.

Unlike the ocean in the previous games, there are no invisible walls preventing the player from venturing far away from the map; therefore, the ocean is infinite. However, the sea floor outside of the map is not detailed, appearing as a flat sand terrain. No matter how far the player goes, they will never find any landmass other than the main map.

Shipwrecks cannot be found in the ocean, unlike the [[Atlantic Ocean (3D Universe)|Atlantic Ocean]] in ''GTA Vice City''.
